package.description: Four existing Aixand contracts selected for the managed Codex two-turn example.

timeout.description: Seconds. Omission or null uses the connection's configured timeout.

operations.description: Launch an owned agent; completion establishes a composition handle, not task completion. Address optionally sets up a managed Carrier inbox; null or omission leaves it absent. cwd/instructions null or omission use SDK defaults. Setup failures retain launch identity and uncertain-effect details. Cleanup detaches unless stop-owned is configured. Failures stop execution, are never retried, and cancellation does not roll back effects.

timeout.description: Seconds. Omission or null uses the connection's configured timeout.

operations.description: Submit nonempty text after input readiness. Success confirms terminal delivery only. Updates the shared handle latest direct-send boundary only when the receipt has an observation revision. Timeout null/omission uses scope timeout. Failed or cancelled delivery can be uncertain. Failures stop execution, are never retried, and cancellation does not roll back effects.

timeout.description: Seconds. Omission or null uses the connection's configured timeout.

operations.description: Observe stable readiness, never infer task success. Omitted after uses latest eligible direct-send receipt; null observes current readiness; explicit receipt must have a revision and belong to the agent session. Carrier deliveries do not retarget this boundary. stable_for null/omission uses connection configuration. Read-only timeout is a failure. Failures stop execution, are never retried, and cancellation does not roll back effects.

Stop this agent explicitly, including an attached agent when requested. Closes its consumer and cancels pending input. Success confirms SDK stop completion. Stop failure/cancellation can leave process state uncertain. Failures stop execution, are never retried, and cancellation does not roll back effects.
